subject: Post-signature orchestration: gated rollforward MAP and evaluation cadence
messages:
From: Elena Torres <ops@greenoak.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: GreenOak Procurement <procurement@greenoak.io>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-contract plan and kickoff — MAP + canary cadence

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again — we received the countersigned SOW this morning. Before we schedule the technical kickoff, procurement asked that we lock the mutual action plan with concrete dates for rollout, canary, migration windows and training.

High level asks from GreenOak ops/procurement:
- A phased rollout schedule (pilot -> regional -> full) with target dates and contingency days
- Canary acceptance criteria and the evaluation plan (duration, telemetry to collect, pass/fail thresholds)
- Migration cutover steps and fallback plan (including data sync and DNS timing)
- Training windows and brief syllabus for platform admins and support teams
- Billing/milestone language to match the SOW: go-live acceptance window and acceptance signoff owner

Can you share a draft MAP and the evaluation checklist by EOD Mon (Oct 18)? We have a few blackout dates Nov 1-3 (internal audit) — I want to flag that now.

Attached: greenoak_signed_sow.pdf (signed SOW)

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Ops Lead — GreenOak Health
ops@greenoak.io

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <ops@greenoak.io>, GreenOak Procurement <procurement@greenoak.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-contract plan and kickoff — MAP + canary cadence

Elena — thanks and congrats on getting the SOW across the finish line.

I attached a first-draft Mutual Action Plan that embeds the post-signature implementation plan and evaluation cadence. Key highlights below (we'll iterate based on your feedback):

Phase 0 — Pilot prep (2 weeks)
- Deliverables: access provisioning, schema mapping, sample data sync test
- Owner: GreenOak Ops + RWI Onboarding (Marissa)

Phase 1 — Pilot (gated, 2 weeks)
- Scope: single region, 2 pilot tenant groups (dev + staging)
- Canary criteria: P95 latency < 250ms, token error rate < 0.5% during steady-state sampling, no severity-2 incidents for 72h
- Eval: 7-day rolling windows with daily snapshot reports (latency, error rate, throughput, model quality checks)

Phase 2 — Regional ramp (3 weeks)
- Incremental traffic shifts (25% -> 50% -> 100%) with 24–48h observability hold windows
- Rollback triggers defined in the MAP

Phase 3 — Cutover & training (1 week)
- Production cutover weekend with pre-cutover smoke tests and post-cutover acceptance test runbook
- Training: two hands-on sessions + train-the-trainer deck (see Marissa's note)

Attachments: rwi_mpa_draft_v0.1.pdf (draft MAP)

A few questions from our side:
- Can you confirm a dedicated acceptance owner and the contact for signoff?
- Any additional blackout dates beyond Nov 1-3?

If this looks ok I can schedule a 45-min alignment call Thurs or Fri.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
rachael.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <ops@greenoak.io>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-contract plan and kickoff — MAP + canary cadence

Adding some implementation and enablement detail from the Onboarding side — attaching the canary test workbook.

Training / enablement proposal:
- Week 0 (pre-pilot): 90-minute orientation for platform admins (overview, access, ops playbook)
- Week 1 (pilot start): 90-minute workshop — runbook walkthrough + incident playbook
- Week 3 (train-the-trainer): 2-hour session with GreenOak support leads to hand off runbook ownership

Acceptance criteria (operational):
- Canary baseline collection: 72h of synthetic + traffic-shadowed samples before traffic shift
- Quality evaluation: sample prompts (provided by GreenOak) and automated evals tied to the MAP; expected baseline F1/quality & regression thresholds in the workbook

Attached: canary-test-plan.xlsx

Karthik — note that GreenOak asked for tight P95 latency targets; we'll propose a staged batch/scale config during pilot to keep cost in check and still meet SLOs.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
